hero.headline: Punjabi music, recorded live and pressed on vinyl
hero.text: Folk, sufi and late-night dub from an independent label. Small runs, hand-stamped sleeves.
hero.outro: Every record starts with one needle drop.

studio.quote: We record the room, not just the voice. The tumbi, the dhol, the people clapping in the back.
paragraphs: Baaz Records runs a two-room studio with a tape machine, a handful of old valve microphones and a lot of rugs. Most of our albums are cut live in a single afternoon.
Artists keep their masters. We press 300 to 500 copies per release and ship every order in a hand-stamped sleeve.
